name: Dev Tools
description: Sandboxed, offline, zero permissions — 40 tools at ~100KB: generators (password/QR/barcode/ID/RSA/TOTP/placeholder), codecs (Base64/Base58/URL/escape/punycode/data-URI), crypto (hash/HMAC/JWT/AES/certificate), text tools (JSON/diff/regex/lines/mojibake) and more.
